name: h29-proof
note: FALLBACK, not a count decrease: one printed leaf (hL29) replaced by two printed leaves of the same paper (Theorem 2.1, from which TYZ derive Lemma 2.9, and Lemma 2.8). hL29 is a top-level argument of frozenTarget, not a bundle field, so autofold.py refuses it (as for h29-ne3, t21-proof); the fold is by hand: in Main.lean import ZInQKernel.Contrib.OneProof.TYZLemma29Genus, replace the binder (hL29 : H29Split.TYZLemma29PrintedNe3) by (h21 : H29Genus.TYZThm21Pairs) (h28 : H29Genus.TYZLemma28Sym) and the use of hL29 by (ZInQ.Contrib.TYZDecomp.H29Genus.tyzLemma29PrintedNe3_of_genus h21 h28). Raises the strict and strictest LEAF counts by one (needs --allow-rise in spirit).

leaves.name: tyzThm21Pairs
leaves.doc: Tian-Yuan-Zhang, arXiv:1411.4728v1 Theorem 2.1 (source L554-559) for every decomposition n = d1 d2, squarefree 1 < n = 1, 3 mod 8: the quadratic period P(d1, d2) = sum over Cl_n of chi_{d1,d2}(t) f_n(t) (L551-552) vanishes when neither d1 nor d2 is 1 mod 8 and equals +- 2^{k-1} w_K L(d1) L(d2) when d2 = 1 mod 8 (k = number of primes of n, 2 w_K = number of roots of unity, Mathlib torsionOrder); chi_{d1,d2} = the genus character prod_{q | d2} (N a / q) (RouteK.Redei.chi)
leaves.flag: restricted: odd classes n = 1, 3 mod 8, n > 1 (TYZ: n = 1, 2, 3); of the first assertion only its consequence for pairs with no factor = 1 mod 8 (the ordered reading is false at n = 3 mod 8, (d1, d2) = (1, 3) mod 8, h29-split, rv-tyz-inputs 1.2 item 4); chi_{d1,d2} read as the genus character of K(sqrt d2*) (convention not re-read: source absent; the leaf is insensitive to it given Lemma 2.8); contains TYZThm21At31 (proved, t21-proof); numerically checked on 28 runs (h29-proof genus_check.py); unread
leaves.source: Tian-Yuan-Zhang, Genus periods, genus points and congruent number problem, Asian J. Math. 21 (2017), arXiv:1411.4728v1 Theorem 2.1 (L554-559), with P(d1, d2) defined at L551-552

leaves.name: tyzLemma28Sym
leaves.doc: Tian-Yuan-Zhang, arXiv:1411.4728v1 Lemma 2.8 (source L1009-1057, label lem2.6): P(d1, d2) = P(d2, d1) for squarefree 1 < n = 1 mod 8, admissible tau (4 | c, L533), d2 = 1 mod 8
leaves.flag: restricted: n = 1 mod 8, n > 1, decompositions with d2 = 1 mod 8 (the ones TYZ's proof of Lemma 2.9 uses); numerically checked on 16 runs (h29-proof genus_check.py); provable from TYZProp23Printed and the chi0-twist argument (h29-proof report section 4), not done in Lean; unread
